data: Fixed November DiffV2IR and MFT ProtocolV2; unchanged all-proposal detector and physical ByteTrack.
evidence: First3 reliable RGB/IR view anchors, past-only adaptive templates updated only when RGB anchor cosine>=.5. Last trusted box/time independent of the physical filter.
candidates: All current actual proposals versus all ready roots within1000 trusted frames; active owners remain eligible. Rotation-tolerant diagonal scale .25..4 and body reach .5+Train_unknown_speed_upper*gap. No GT filtering, edge truncation or pair disk dump.
targets: Train-only Hungarian current detection labels; root origin requires the first3 reliable seed views all having the same positive GT ID. A mixed/unknown origin is never relabeled by later majority. Unknown edges excluded only from loss.

fit.fit_frames: first75% of each of all6Train sequences
fit.weighting: Equal video and available positive/negative class weight
fit.critic_veto_threshold: 1st percentile of late-Train known positive paired posterior; missing IR cannot veto. Paired posterior never creates a proposal.

online_rule: RGB posterior above frozen Train quantile and mutual row/column margin>=.05 for3 consecutive frames. Preserve occupied root unless its current owner has posterior<=.5 or an accepted simultaneous handoff. Assign displaced owner a new unique identity. No prefix rewriting, future input, GT or physical filter feedback.
Dev_plan: All4834Dev first; q95/q99/q999 RGB and conditional IR critic, each with filtered/raw-shape rendering; frozen-memory ablations. Strict improvement over previous fullDev52.098427171322534 required before new Test7. Freeze selection before interventions and Test; no reselection from Test.
